article.title: Exclusive jurisdiction of the Supreme Court in regard to questions as to constitutional validity of Central laws
article.content: Omitted by the Constitution (Forty-third Amendment) Act, 1977, s. 4 (w.e.f. 13-4-1978).
article.html:
131AExclusive jurisdiction of the Supreme Court in regard to questions as to constitutional validity of Central laws

Article 131A · Part V

Omitted by the Constitution (Forty-third Amendment) Act, 1977, s. 4 (w.e.f. 13-4-1978).

1 Ins. by the Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Act, 1976, s. 23 (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
